title: Tea Cups For Herbalism
intro: Tea cups are essential tools in herbalism and home apothecaries, used for preparing and consuming herbal infusions. They provide a simple yet effective way to steep dried herbs in hot water, allowing the active compounds to dissolve into the liquid. In traditional practices, tea cups help maintain the therapeutic properties of the herbs while offering a calming ritual for the user. Their use reflects both practicality and the cultural significance of herbal remedies in daily life.
